SELECT cdb.HBL_NO ,cdb.CONSIGNEE_NAME ,cdb.CONSIGNEE_HP ,cdb.OLD_COMMODITY_ITEM ,cdb.NEW_COMMODITY_ITEM ,cdb.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS ,cdb.ALLOWED_ITEM_CODE ,cdb.URL ,cdb.AMOUNT_CUR ,cdb.CURRENCY_CODE ,cdb.CUSTOMS_ID ,cdb.CD_USE_TYPE ,cdb.F_CODE ,cdb.CONSIGNEE_ADDRESS_LOC ,cdb.CONSIGNEE_NAME_LOC ,cdb.CONSIGNEE_ZIPCODE ,CONVERT(CHAR(19), cdb.IMPORT_DATE, 20) AS IMPORT_DATE ,cdb.REMOVE ,(SELECT tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE tsu.USER_ID = cdb.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME ,CONVERT(CHAR(19), cdb.REGISTER_DATE_TIME, 20) AS REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,(SELECT tsu.USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER tsu WHERE tsu.USER_ID = cdb.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME ,CONVERT(CHAR(19), cdb.UPDATE_DATE_TIME, 20) AS UPDATE_DATE_TIME FROM TB_CD_B_INFO cdb WHERE 1 = 1
AND ${srchNoType} IN (#{item})

,ups.ETC1 ,ups.ETC2
,ups.HBL_NO ,ups.REGISTER_DATE_TIME ,ups.UPDATE_DATE_TIME ,ups.SEQ_NO_ID ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND USER_ID = ups.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME ,(SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = #{srchEntCode} AND USER_ID = ups.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME FROM TB_UPS_BASIC ups WHERE 1 = 1
AND ${srchDateGbn} >= CONVERT(DATE, #{srchStartDate}, ${srchDateFormat})
AND ${srchDateGbn} < DATEADD(DAY, 1, CONVERT(DATE, #{srchEndDate}, ${srchDateFormat}))
AND ${srchDateGbn} >= CONVERT(DATE, #{srchStartDate}, ${srchDateFormat})
AND ${srchDateGbn} <= CONVERT(DATE, #{srchEndDate}, ${srchDateFormat})
